description: Guide the student to build a feature-engineering pipeline from OHLCV data, then diagnose multicollinearity and look-ahead leakage risks.
user_opening: My professor asked us to build a feature-engineering pipeline from OHLCV data and check for problems like multicollinearity. I'm new to both Python and finance — can you start from the basics?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor guides the student to construct diverse features from OHLCV data, validate feature quality via correlation or multicollinearity checks, and apply explicit anti-leakage safeguards in feature construction.
required_capabilities: Construct diverse features from OHLCV data including returns, volatility, and technical indicators
Prevent look-ahead leakage in feature construction
Diagnose feature redundancy using correlation or VIF
ground_truth.termination_criteria: (1) Showed actual code output constructing at least two diverse features from OHLCV data, such as returns, rolling volatility, or technical indicators, with concrete computed values. (2) Demonstrated a concrete anti-leakage check on the constructed features, such as verifying that rolling windows use only past data, or showing that no future values appear in the feature matrix. (3) Responded to a student follow-up with a concrete redundancy or multicollinearity diagnostic, such as a correlation matrix, VIF computation, or feature-pair comparison with actual values. Once all 3 steps have been computationally demonstrated, the session is complete.
